requirements.label: Customer-managed KMS keys required
requirements.description: Organisation policy requires customer-managed KMS keys with rotation, not AWS-managed keys.
requirements.clause: Encrypt at rest with a customer-managed KMS key with automatic rotation enabled.

requirements.label: Mandatory resource tagging
requirements.description: Every resource must carry Owner, Environment and CostCenter tags.
requirements.clause: Tag every resource with Owner, Environment and CostCenter.

riskyPatterns.label: Banned region
riskyPatterns.description: Organisation policy forbids US regions for data-residency reasons.
riskyPatterns.fix: Deploy only to approved regions (eu-west-1 or ap-south-1).

riskyPatterns.label: SSH exposed
riskyPatterns.description: Organisation policy requires SSM Session Manager instead of SSH.
riskyPatterns.fix: Use SSM Session Manager and close port 22.
